Action: Lock in your artist name, genre, and positioning in 1 clear sentence. Complete it today.

Action: Complete 1 track and upload it to a distributor (e.g. DistroKid) within 14 days.
Why It Matters: No music = no career. The system cannot calculate a Release score without output.
Expected Outcome: First track live on Spotify and Apple Music; Release pillar score activates.

Action: Set up Instagram or TikTok and upload 5 posts within 7 days. Pick 1 platform only.
Why It Matters: You need a visible presence before you can grow. Zero followers beats zero account.
Expected Outcome: Active social profile with first content; algorithm begins indexing your page.

Action: Reply to every comment and DM within 24 hours for the next 30 days.
Why It Matters: Engagement starts manually — early fans remember who responded to them.
Expected Outcome: First genuine fan interactions built; foundation for a loyal audience established.

Action: Go to 1 local concert or open mic as audience or performer within 4 weeks.
Why It Matters: Live immersion accelerates learning, networking, and reduces performance fear.
Expected Outcome: First real-world connection to your local scene and genre community made.

Action: Plan and date 2 releases within the next 8 weeks — aim for a 4-week gap between each.
Why It Matters: Consistency beats talent. If the gap exceeds 6 weeks, your Release score drops automatically.
Expected Outcome: Active release cadence established; Release pillar score increases with each on-time release.

Action: Post 3x per week on your main platform for 4 consecutive weeks — same days, same formats.
Why It Matters: Growth comes from repetition, not one-time posts. Algorithms reward consistent behaviour.
Expected Outcome: Consistent content rhythm; first signs of organic reach growth visible after week 2–3.

Action: Add 1 call-to-action (Spotify link) in every post you publish for the next 4 weeks.
Why It Matters: Views ≠ fans. Without active redirects, social attention never converts to streaming numbers.
Expected Outcome: Measurable traffic from social to streaming; numbers correlate with post frequency.

Action: Contact 3 local venues or open mics this week and secure 1 performance date within 4–6 weeks.
Why It Matters: Live = reality check. A booked show forces deadlines, quality control, and real presence.
Expected Outcome: First performance completed; Live pillar score activated in Musicsteps.

Action: Write a 1-page EPK: 3-line bio, press photo, genre, 3 links, 1 quote. Done within 7 days.
Why It Matters: Without a shareable document you cannot approach venues, curators, or media contacts.
Expected Outcome: Shareable EPK exists; booking and press enquiry response rate increases immediately.

Action: Choose 3 recurring content formats and post them every week for 8 consecutive weeks.
Why It Matters: Repeatable formats build algorithmic trust and audience expectation — you become reliably present.
Expected Outcome: Growing follower count and weekly engagement; content production time drops as formats solidify.

Action: Identify your top 20 most engaged fans and interact with them directly every week for 4 weeks.
Why It Matters: Fans > numbers. Deep connection with 20 real fans compounds and powers every future release.
Expected Outcome: 20 loyal core fans who save, share, and stream every release; direct feedback loop established.

Expected Outcome: Live score rises; connections to artists and venues established; real-world audience growing.
